'''Velhom'starn''' was a city on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. It was located on an island of the [[Rylle'vak]] [[ocean/Legends|ocean]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] western hemisphere.
